blockers.summary: The Apache-2.0 independent-sessions patch is applied to GPLv2 MariaDB source; compatible permission or a replacement is required before distributing the combined runtime.
The exact license and source correspondence inventory for every linked native component and PHP per-file exception is not yet complete for the release artifact.
The distribution relationship between the Apache-2.0 TypeScript/SWC editor assets and the GPLv2 native runtime has not been reviewed and documented for the exact static and Docker packages.
The recorded inspiration/adaptation targets have not all been compared file-by-file with ALWIS to determine whether AGPL or other third-party expression was copied.

No release-specific verification yet confirms that the exact corresponding native sources, all license texts, notices, and checksums are present beside every published runtime artifact; config/native-runtime.json must also be refreshed with the manifest hash from the new notice-bearing native artifact.

scope: This status blocks publication of static, Docker, and native releases containing the runtime. It does not prevent local development or validation builds.
reopenWhen: Update this file only after evidence for each blocker is recorded in provenance/component-license-map.md and the exact release notices/source bundle are verified.
